messages:
Aisha (people-ops): Quick heads-up: launching a rolling "Starlight Thanks" pop-up to recognize Q3 contributors across offices Aug 12-20. Need site leads, volunteer roster, kit counts, and payroll cutoff confirmation. :sparkles:
Leo (operations): I can coordinate SF/LA logistics. How many kits per site roughly?
Marco (people-ops): Initial plan: 6 hubs. Ballpark 100 kits total. Draft split below, open to adjustments.
Zoe (facilities): We can schedule pickups Aug 9-10. Need final pallet labels 72h before pickup.
Nia (finance): For spot awards as payroll entries, nominations must be in by Aug 1 COB to land in Aug 15 payroll. Otherwise they'll roll to Sept or require off-cycle processing (fee applies).
Raj (engineering): I can run Toronto day and bring 2 volunteers for setup/photos.
Priya (people-ops): Draft manifest (please confirm):
SF: 30 kits
NYC: 25 kits
London: 15 kits
Berlin: 10 kits
Toronto: 10 kits
Dublin: 10 kits
Marco (people-ops): Signup link: https://tiny.redwood/starlight-signup — pick role (lead/volunteer/photo) and note shirt size.
Aisha (people-ops): Policy Q: managers want to hand out $25 cards. Are gift cards allowed or payroll preferred?
Nia (finance): Payroll spot awards preferred. Gift cards under $50 okay via petty cash with receipts and GL code.
Priya (people-ops): Intl tax note: flag country on nominations; local tax/grossup handled separately. I'll loop in payroll-ops.
Zoe (facilities): Confirmed: shipping code STLT-08. Pallet labels once manifest final.
Marco (people-ops): Volunteers so far: Raj (Toronto lead), Leo (SF ops), Lina (NYC volunteer). We still need London and Dublin leads.
HR-bot: Reminder: nomination form needs employee ID + manager approval screenshot. Missing info delays payroll processing.
Aisha (people-ops): Action items recap: site leads (Aisha), finalize kit counts by Jul 28 (Marco), nominations by Aug 1 (managers), pickups Aug 9-10 (Zoe). React with :white_check_mark: when you own an item.
Leo (operations): Adding holds on logistics calendar now.
Aisha (people-ops): Optional dry run Aug 8 in SF for cart flow. Volunteers welcome!
